title: Epimorphisms of abelian sheaves are detected on stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], with stalks and stalk maps as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then $\varphi$ is an epimorphism if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the induced stalk map $\varphi_x:F_x\to G_x$ is a surjective homomorphism of abelian groups.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 007S (exactness at points), epimorphism clause; the proof is the local lifting argument for sheaves

mathlib_match.how: two Mathlib lemmas chained, as for lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-epi-iff-stalks: with C = AddCommGrpCat, TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi (Topology/Sheaves/LocallySurjective.lean:125) gives TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective φ.hom ↔ Epi φ in Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X (its instance hypotheses hold for AddCommGrpCat; Mathlib applies it to Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X in Topology/Sheaves/Flasque.lean:129), and TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks (same file, line 80; AddCommGrpCat has colimits and its forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits) turns local surjectivity into surjectivity of every stalk map (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat x).map φ.hom.
